title: Mercurius Sulphuricus
text:
Mercurius Sulphuricus.

         Sulphate of Mercury. (HgSO4.)



Hydrothorax, if occurring from heart or liver diseases; dyspnoea, has to
        sit, cannot lie down. Extremities swollen; stool loose, watery, causing severe burning and
        soreness; burning in chest. "When it acts well it produces a profuse, watery diarrhoea
        with great relief to the patient; it is as important as Arsenicum in hydrothorax" -
        Lippe.


  Relations  . - Compare: Ars., Cinnab.,
        Dig., Sulph.



 Keynotes  by H.C. Allen
